template.name: Detect and Report Silent Trace Loss via Vessel Execution Count Divergence
template.description: Detects silent trace loss by comparing vessel-reported execution counts against activity-api stored traces. Identifies vessels with >5% sustained loss over 3+ consecutive 24h windows. Generates trace loss report and proposes redelivery strategy.

tasks.name: Fetch codebase state for trace sink implementations
tasks.description: Read current implementations of TranslatingTraceSink, MiniBob trace-cache, and AgentRuntime to understand fire-and-forget behavior.

tasks.name: Generate SQL detection query for trace count divergence
tasks.description: Compose parameterized query to fetch per-vessel trace counts from activity-api over 24h rolling windows and compare against vessel heartbeat execution counters.

params.prompt: Generate a SQL query that: (1) Counts execution traces per vessel_id over rolling 24h windows from activity_execution_traces table; (2) Includes a template to compare against vessel-reported executionsCompleted from heartbeat metadata; (3) Identifies vessels where (local_count - remote_trace_count) / local_count > 0.05 sustained over 3+ consecutive windows. Return query and comparison logic as JSON.

tasks.name: Analyze durable outbox gap in current implementations
tasks.description: Review TranslatingTraceSink and MiniBob trace-cache to document lack of retry/outbox mechanism. Identify where fire-and-forget occurs and what state would be lost.

tasks.name: Propose durable outbox and redelivery pattern
tasks.description: Design a vessel-local outbox mechanism that persists failed traces and re-submits them. Include idempotency key strategy to prevent double-writes.

params.prompt: Design a durable outbox pattern for vessel-side trace submission that: (1) Persists traces to local disk before attempting POST; (2) Implements exponential backoff retry on 5xx/timeout; (3) Includes idempotency key (trace_id + vessel_id + timestamp hash) to prevent double-writes on redelivery; (4) Exposes a background sync thread that runs every 5min. Return as JSON schema with field definitions and pseudocode for sync loop.

tasks.name: Design activity-api endpoint for per-vessel trace count
tasks.description: Propose GET /v2/vessels/{vesselId}/execution-count endpoint to expose recorded trace count for divergence detection.

params.prompt: Design a REST API endpoint GET /v2/vessels/{vesselId}/execution-count that returns: (1) vessel_id, (2) recorded_trace_count (total traces stored for this vessel), (3) window_start and window_end (24h rolling window), (4) last_trace_timestamp. Include query parameters for time range filtering. Return as OpenAPI 3.0 spec fragment with example response.

context.purpose: Enable cross-vessel witness for divergence detection

tasks.name: Generate the trace loss detection activity variant
tasks.description: Create an activity template that runs the divergence detection query, identifies affected vessels, and generates the traceLossReport.

params.description: Detects silent trace loss by comparing vessel-reported execution counts (from heartbeat) against activity-api stored trace counts over 24h rolling windows. Surfaces vessels with >5% sustained loss over 3+ consecutive windows.

tasks.name: Compile gap-closing execution trace
tasks.description: Synthesize findings from all tasks into a structured gapClosingTrace that documents the detection mechanism, proposed fixes, and evidence of the gap closure.

params.prompt: Compile a gapClosingTrace JSON object that documents: (1) gap_id: 'fm-44-silent-trace-loss'; (2) detection_mechanism: summary of divergence detection query; (3) root_causes: list of code locations where fire-and-forget occurs (from task-3); (4) proposed_fixes: list of outbox pattern, API endpoint, and activity variant (from tasks 4-6); (5) evidence: expected output shapes and tags; (6) closure_criteria: vessels with trace loss gap <1% sustained over 3+ windows. Return as JSON.
